title: Probe: short source lists with framing sentences around them
note: Authored probe for B596, shaped after a real import that turned three target groups into a list of five. The source names exactly three target groups and five organisations; each list is wrapped in sentences about it (a goal, an implication, the ambition that introduces it). A list claims its items are alike, so those sentences belong in a subheading, aside or presenter notes, never among the items.
licence: Authored for this suite; MIT with the repository. All organisations are fictional.
